target_statement: Kernel-check seven-column rank certificates for four-digit palindrome-prefix classes that close in the pure k=7 abstraction but not at k<=6 (the 31 classes of PURE_PREFIX_CATALOGUE.md Section 5, none of which is in Agent #124's four_digit_targets.json). For each such prefix abcd with k=7 bound B: for every positive ordinary decimal integer A, every t and every palindrome P whose canonical decimal numeral has width >= 4 and begins with the digits a,b,c,d (any width, any interior digits, intermediate palindromes allowed), Lychrel196.orbit A t = P implies t <= B; consequently for every t, Lychrel196.orbit 196 t is not a palindrome beginning with abcd. First batch (smallest closures, 2,960..9,655 nodes): 3916:8, 4937:10, 9538:9, 3585:25, 8417:15, 2386:17, 5492:14, 5774:22, 3181:11, 3121:13, 8416:15; the remaining twenty (up to 115,522 nodes) as resources allow. Route: Agent #124's reusable modules (Agent124PrefixK/R/FastPred/CodeCert/CodeRange/ShortSplit/LeadOne/PrefixL, consumed unchanged) with certificates generated from the independent prefix_cycles.py closure; fresh build and transitive axiom audit; no native_decide. Any class whose instance does not compile stays a checked computation.
